title: RelationStateExplanation
description: A machine-readable explanation of WHY a relation is supported/refuted/contested/unsupported and admitted/excluded at a query time. The response is structured data; natural-language rendering is a client concern.

profileVersion.description: Exact version of that grounding profile. Ids are rebindable; an explanation attributed only to an id cannot be replayed.

policyId.description: The admission policy resolved for this explanation, including when it was the deployment default rather than caller-supplied.

policyVersion.description: Exact version of that admission policy.

admitted.description: Whether the relation is admitted into the projection under the policy.

admissibleSupporting.description: Supporting evidence bases admissible at the query time, with their admissibility results.

admissibleRefuting.description: Refuting evidence bases admissible at the query time, with their admissibility results.

exclusions.description: Explanations for evidence bases or the relation being excluded.
